market_definition: The Global Lactoferrin Market covers lactoferrin ingredients and products derived from bovine, human, recombinant and other sources, used across nutritional, pharmaceutical, food and beverage, animal nutrition, and personal care applications. Lactoferrin is an iron-binding glycoprotein valued for its immune-supporting, antimicrobial and nutritional properties, supplied in powder, liquid, capsules, tablets and other forms, across standard, high-purity and ultra-high-purity grades, for infant formula, dietary supplements, functional foods and beverages, medical nutrition, pharmaceutical formulations, animal nutrition, and cosmetics and personal care. Excludes general dairy and milk ingredients, whey protein, casein and lactalbumin sold independently, products that do not contain lactoferrin, dairy processing and purification equipment, and research-stage work with no commercially supplied lactoferrin.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
